photos.title: Myrtle Beach oceanfront, houses and condo towers side by side, USGS oblique aerial photo, August 24, 2011
photos.what: The Myrtle Beach oceanfront seen from a plane over the ocean: on the left, older two-story houses on lawns between the beach and Ocean Boulevard, with streets of houses under oaks behind them; on the right, two condo and hotel towers on the beach.
photos.caption: Houses and condo towers on the same beach in Myrtle Beach. The houses on the left are in a zone where nightly rentals are not allowed. The towers on the right are in one where they are.
photos.alt: Older two-story houses on lawns along the beach at left, and two tall condo towers on the beach at right, with streets of houses under oak trees behind, seen from a plane over the ocean in Myrtle Beach
photos.author: U.S. Geological Survey
photos.credit: Photo: U.S. Geological Survey, public domain. Credit not required; give it anyway.
photos.provenance: U.S. government photo: USGS baseline coastal oblique aerial survey 11CCH03 (Ponte Vedra, Florida, to the South Carolina/North Carolina border), flown 2011-08-24, photographer Karen L.M. Morgan (USGS). Frame 2011_0824_180143d.jpg from https://coastal.er.usgs.gov/data-release/doi-F7N877XX/data/11CCH03_0824_180000.zip; aircraft position 33.718773 N, -78.838295 W (11CCH03-Photolocations.csv and the file's EXIF GPS; the position of the plane, not of the buildings). Data release: Morgan, K.L.M., 2017, https://doi.org/10.5066/F7N877XX. Not the frame used on any other page (other pages use 174830, 175156, 175537, 180052, 180608 and 181208).

photos.subject_check: Looked at full size (3008 px, in two halves) by the writer of /submarkets/myrtle-beach/ on 2026-11-02. Placed by testing points 500 to 600 m inland of the plane's position, 250 m either side, against map-str-zones.geojson: R zone at the left and the middle, shaded (nightly rentals) at the right, which matches houses at left and towers at right. People on the beach are too small to recognize; no readable sign, logo, plate or house number at page size.

Points 350 to 450 m inland of the plane, 250 m either side, all fall in the shaded (nightly rentals) class. The plane was about 300 to 700 m from the points of the four busiest buildings in findings oceanfront.top_buildings (Tides/Driftwood/Oasis 33.67493,-78.8983; Coral Beach 33.67587,-78.89752; Landmark 33.67336,-78.90088), so the caption says 'where the busiest buildings stand', not which tower is which. A small flag hangs on one balcony; no logo or readable sign; people on the beach are too small to recognize.

photos.title: The Market Common from the air with labels, NOAA, January 2026
photos.what: The Market Common in Myrtle Beach from the air on January 12, 2026: its homes outlined in orange, Valor Park marked, and Grand Park with its ball fields and lake, each labelled.
photos.caption: The Market Common from the air: its homes, outlined, Valor Park, where the Saturday market is held, and Grand Park.
photos.alt: The Market Common from the air: streets of homes outlined in orange beside a lake, a dot labelled Valor Park at the edge of the shops, and ball fields and a lake labelled Grand Park
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: NOAA National Geodetic Survey (NGS), Remote Sensing Division, Emergency Response Imagery, 2026 pre-event coastal collection, East Coast group EC2601a. Frame 185148_0112261657106_036_RGB2, flown 2026-01-12 at about 16:57 UTC (exterior orientation file 0122026_RGB_2_Oblique_EO.txt, camera within 1 km of The Market Common's reference point, about 2,285 m up). Downloaded from the public S3 bucket noaa-eri-pds.
photos.changes: Chapter3 Realty cut this view from one NOAA aerial photo, resized it, adjusted the colors and added an outline and labels
photos.labels: Placed from ground coordinates through the frame's own corner coordinates (.geom), never by eye: 'The Market Common' among the outlined home parcels (layer 24); 'Valor Park' at the centroid of the county Parks polygon 'Valor Garden', 1120 Farrow Pkwy, the address of Valor Park where the farmers market is held (rows 195, 248); 'Grand Park' at the centroid of the county Parks polygon 'Grand Park' (row 195), shifted onto the park. Outline: the Market Common home parcels, The Reserve at Market Common left out. Script: scratchpad wb-best-work/eri (config.json 'market-common-valor-park').
